You know, we found some issues with the SMT') — reliability, not capacity, is the stated pain point. On OCI scale-up the speaker adds 'these are standard lasers. You don't need fancy combs' and 'you don't even need an external laser source. You can have the laser source embedded in the engine' — the latter conflicts with the written OCI v1.0 spec §2.5 ('shall use an ELS'), which governs (separate document in this package).
